description: AscendC codegen snapshots dumped by cannbotdsl: the DN macro kernel (float16 specialization, launch_prefix_macro_dn.asc) and the AICPU metadata planner kernel (codegen/aicpu/, dtype-independent).

compile_case.note: T/B are dynamic Dims in the AOT spec; the snapshot is the fp16 trace of _launch_prefix_macro_dn (kernel__PrefixMacroKernelDn___call___0).

notes: File layout: device kernel (namespace cannbotdsl_92, guarded by __NPU_ARCH__==3510) + host schema/invoke ABI (extern "C" entries at the tail).
bfloat16 mentions only appear in the generic runtime prelude helpers, not in the kernel body (fp16 specialization).
Regeneration command: see README.md 'codegen 快照再生成'.
AICPU sources are generated text (no DUMP env needed); the runtime compiles them from a tempdir via compile_aicpu_kernel() on first call.

aicpu_metadata_kernel.verified: byte-identical to compile_aicpu_kernel() workdir output; .so links successfully
